official_recall.truth_shape: 10000 x 100 IDs and distances per search checkpoint
official_recall.stored_id_dtype: int32 read from binary ground-truth file; live tags are uint32
algorithm: Always admit the stored first k ground-truth IDs.
Starting at index k, extend the stored prefix while abs(D[k-1]-D[i]) < 1e-6; stop at the first failing comparison.
Intersect the admitted prefix ID set with the returned ID set; duplicate returned IDs count once.
Divide the per-query intersection count by k, average over queries, then average over search checkpoints.
official_recall.numpy_environment: Must freeze scorer Python/NumPy versions and test the exact comparison. Local historical requirements offer NumPy 1.24.2 for Python 3.10 and 1.26.* for Python 3.12; neither establishes the organisers' actual installed version.
limitations: Distance tolerance is anchored at the stored kth distance, not a mathematical equality test.
No tie beyond stored rank 100 is representable, even if it is an exact real tie.
Stored score ordering and finite distances are assumed by the scorer, not independently verified there.
Returning any exact-real top-10 set is not yet proved to yield official recall 1.0.
Mission confirmation must validate exactly k unique live tags per query, rather than exploit unconstrained set cardinality.
official_recall.required_output_ownership: Each search result matrix must retain its own stable storage because StreamingRunner appends results to all_results until run completion.

ground_truth_generation.arguments: external --gt_cmdline_tool with --dist_fn l2 --data_type float --K 100, live data slice and tag file
ground_truth_generation.tag_semantics: insert maps tag to matching source row; replace changes that source row under the same tag; delete removes the tag

representative_generator.scope: primary tagged implementation illustrates numeric risk; not established as the executable that generated published GT
representative_generator.behavior: float32 BLAS self-dot norms and SGEMM norm-minus-dot distances; strict score comparison in the local heap; no tag tie ordering established by this code

wrapper_defects_relevant_to_audit: Both branches of --private_query select ds.qs_fn, so this wrapper flag alone cannot establish fresh queries.
The external os.system return code is not checked before deleting intermediate source data.
A generator name or exact_knn function name does not establish exact rational squared L2.
minimum_frozen_audit: Freeze source/query/runbook/each GT-file identity and scorer environment.
Replay all operation keys independently, including live tag ownership and replacement source rows.
Check GT shape, finite monotonic scores, unique live IDs, and exact source distances of stored candidates.
At every scored checkpoint compute an independent exact top-k oracle on the scored fresh queries; candidate-only checks cannot prove no omitted nearer row.
Retain official and audited scores, disagreement counts and concrete evidence. Do not select known-wrong labels to inflate official recall.
Record organiser-dependent corrections in PENDING while continuing native correctness work.

native_mathematical_contract.score: exact real squared L2 of the stored binary32 source values
native_mathematical_contract.supported_source_domain: 1..128 dimensions; coordinates zero or magnitude in [2^-16,2^16]
native_mathematical_contract.unsupported_finite_inputs: exact source fallback; never silent clamp, truncate, flush or discard
native_mathematical_contract.invalid_inputs: NaN, infinity and malformed shapes fail explicitly
native_mathematical_contract.candidate_exact_representation: Decode coordinates as signed integers in units 2^-39; sum squared integer differences in checked unsigned128; score unit is 2^-78 and maximum sum is 2^119.
native_mathematical_contract.ranking: Compare exact squared-distance integers and use stable live tag as the deterministic exact-tie tiebreaker; this is an audited policy, not an assertion of official GT tie parity.
native_mathematical_contract.prune: Only a strict lower(reconstructed squared distance) > upper((sqrt(incumbent upper)+data error upper+query error upper)^2).
native_mathematical_contract.threshold: kth smallest actual incumbent distance upper bounds; never a ground-truth threshold
native_mathematical_contract.e24: Orchestrator reports 2308 scalar checks, 25 supported strict prunes, 150 interval and 150 fallback decisions, zero failures; native machine arithmetic remains unverified.
